notes: Manufacturer material confirms the product family and hardware capabilities, but does not document Art-Net universe-to-port assignment or detailed Art-Net packet mapping.
A reseller-hosted manual agrees on core hardware specs. Treat exact network behavior as pending verification against the installed unit and BanlanX settings.

pixelOutputs.maxTotalNote: 4096 is the sum of four advertised per-port maxima; actual achievable count depends on pixel IC, refresh rate, wiring, power and firmware.

pixelProtocol.exactDriverICNote: Select and verify the actual IC in BanlanX; documentation does not establish a specific IC such as WS2812B for this installation.

pixelColorOrder.note: Order is configurable; confirm the installed strip/matrix order in BanlanX before treating a software order as physical truth.

universeAddressing.note: The available SP801E documentation says Art-Net-compatible but does not specify universe numbering, per-port universe assignment, pixel packing, or whether ports mirror or consume independent data. Read the installed controller/app configuration and verify by packet capture/output before enabling a patch.

profileDefaults.safeSetupRule: Do not infer physical output routing or assign universes from port numbers. Require an explicit per-output patch read from the device/app or verified by an operator.

siteDeployment.name: Vertical LED Matrix
siteDeployment.controllerIdentity: User-identified as SP801E; IP reachability and exact firmware not independently confirmed in this profile task.

softwarePatch.portPatchEvidence: Two ArtPollReply bind pages from SP801E_F66880 report U16–U23; the previous working sender mirrored starts U16, U18, U20, U22. Full white on U16–U23 lit the connected strip. Physical port-by-port assignment still needs point testing.
softwarePatch.universeDataBehavior: The previous SiteFlow sender mirrored the same rendered payload at these four start Universes. The current sender requires a saved Canvas patch.
softwarePatch.verification: The controller IP and current software patch are known locally; 40×5 with bottom-left vertical serpentine is the requested installation canvas. These are not verified SP801E port/universe settings. Confirm actual BanlanX layout, pixel order, ports and universes before changing this deployment.

controlSemantics.meaning: SiteFlow virtual faders render pixel data for this controller; these are software-side controls, not native SP801E DMX channels.
controlSemantics.amberAndUv: Software color approximations in RGB output; they do not create physical amber or ultraviolet emitters unless the connected pixel hardware provides them.
